Priced October 13, 2026

Winter break against mid January, at the same hotels

On October 13, 2026 we priced the same 225 hotels in 25 large US travel markets (9 a city) three times, on every booking site Google Hotels listed: Christmas, New Year's Eve and a mid-January week with the New Year's Eve weekdays, 4 nights each, two adults, in US dollars, before taxes.

Christmas, New Year's Eve and mid January at the same hotels, priced October 13, 2026
Stay, 4 nightsMedian rate a nightAgainst mid JanuaryA site 5% or more lowerTypical gap
Christmas, December 23 to 27$148−3.9% (within chance)192 of 223$26
New Year's Eve, December 29 to January 2$178+6.8%181 of 217$32
Mid January, January 12 to 16$166the baseline169 of 213$29
  • New Year's Eve: higher than mid January at 118 of 207 hotels and lower at 83, a median $10 a night more. Before pricing we set the bar for a clear difference; this one passed it.
  • Christmas: lower than mid January at 119 of 211 hotels and higher at 88, a median $5 a night less; that difference did not pass the bar, so we read Christmas week as no dearer than mid January, not cheaper.
  • A lower listing was common in all three weeks; for Christmas, Super.com had the lowest price most often (93 of 192).

So the dear part of winter break was the New Year's Eve week, not the whole season. And where a lower listing existed, its typical gap below the going rate ($26 a night for Christmas) was larger than the median New Year's Eve premium ($10 a night).

One day's prices, about ten weeks ahead; they will move. Median of the hotel-by-hotel change; the going rate is the price most sites agreed on. With 9 hotels a city, city figures are small samples. Method, city by city and the CSV: Christmas and New Year hotel prices, 2026.

What you can move, and what you cannot

The week. A stay outside the New Year's Eve week (December 29 to January 2, 2027 in our data) avoids the week that priced higher. Christmas week itself was not dearer than mid January at the median hotel we priced.

The site. At 86% of hotels some site listed the Christmas stay 5% or more below the going rate. 178 of those 192 lower listings named no room, so a lower price is a lead to check, not a booking to make blind.

The timing, partly. One day's prices cannot say whether they will rise or fall by December. Book a refundable rate you are happy with and let a price-drop alert watch it: do hotel price alerts work?

Five steps for a winter break hotel

  1. Price the nights you can move: the same hotel for a stay ending before New Year's Eve, and one including it.
  2. Check every booking site for your hotel and dates, not one.
  3. On a lower listing, match the room and the cancellation terms before you book.
  4. Book a refundable rate, note its free-cancellation deadline, and watch the price.
  5. Read the total with taxes and fees on the last screen; a resort fee may be extra.

Holiday weeks, 2026

For Christmas week 2026 (December 23 to 27, priced November 4, 2026), another site listed the same hotel and dates 5% or more below Booking.com at 74 of 79 hotels we compared, a median 20%, about $32 a night; the lowest of those lower listings was most often on Super.com (24), then KAYAK.com (16), then Hotelscombined.com and momondo.com (15 each).

100 hotels, 4 in each of 25 large US travel markets, for 2 adults and one room; prices with taxes and fees as each site reports them; a resort or destination fee may be extra. Method and the hotel-by-hotel data: Holiday hotel prices 2026: other sites against Booking.com.

Winter break hotel prices: common questions

How do you avoid high hotel prices over winter break?+

Avoid the New Year's Eve week if you can and check every booking site. Priced on October 13, 2026 at the same hotels in 25 US cities, a New Year's Eve stay ran a median 6.8% above mid January while Christmas week was not higher, and a site listed the Christmas stay 5% or more below the going rate at 192 of 223 hotels.

Are hotels more expensive over New Year's Eve?+

At the median hotel we priced, yes: 6.8% above a mid-January week with the same weekdays, higher at 118 of 207 hotels and lower at 83 (priced October 13, 2026).

Are hotels more expensive at Christmas?+

Not at the median hotel we priced: the Christmas week going rate was a median 3.9% below mid January, a difference within chance, at 211 hotels in 25 US cities.

When should I book a hotel for winter break?+

Our data is one day's prices, so it cannot say whether they will rise or fall. Booking a refundable rate now and watching the price lets you take a later drop without risking the room.

Is a lower holiday price on another site the same room?+

Often the listing does not say: for Christmas, the lowest listing named no room at 178 of the 192 hotels where a site was 5% or more below the going rate. Check the room and the cancellation terms before you book.
